title: net.fec_recovered
description: M8B § Acceptance 'Reed-Solomon FEC recovers a single-byte-corrupted reliable payload'. Emitted when a FEC-protected reliable payload (event batch < 8 kB) is reconstructed from surviving shards without an application-level retransmit. NOT cosmetic.

group_id.description: FEC group id (per spec § Schemas — net.fec_recovered).

shards_lost.description: Number of shards that were lost or corrupted + recovered. Must be ≤ m.

payload_bytes.description: Original payload size in bytes (≤ FEC_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES).
